title: Nira (Duel Masters)
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Heroes of the Realm characters)

paragraphs.text: Nira , the Hellkite Duelist , is a dragon from an unknown plane.

Nira is a hellkite dragon that was created as part of Heroes of the Realm as an award to the Duel Masters team. It was illustrated by Duel Masters card artist Yoichi Ito . Nira appears as a large red armored and scaled dragon with a red mane and a shadowy magical claw coming out of its back.
The card is meant to be equivalent to Mega Dragnai Dragon from Duel Masters .
